import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String stringInput = scanner.nextLine();

        // Replace first occurrence of 'at' with '@'
        int index = stringInput.indexOf("at");
        if (index != -1) {
            stringInput = stringInput.substring(0, index) + "@" + stringInput.substring(index + 2);
        }

        // Check if string starts with '@'
        if (stringInput.startsWith("@")) {
            stringInput = "at" + stringInput.substring(1).replaceFirst("at", "@");
        }

        // Replace 'dot' with '.' if present
        if (stringInput.contains("dot")) {
            stringInput = stringInput.replace("dot", ".");
            // If string starts with '.', replace it with 'dot'
            if (stringInput.startsWith(".")) {
                stringInput = "dot" + stringInput.substring(1);
            }
            // If string ends with '.', replace it with 'dot'
            if (stringInput.endsWith(".")) {
                stringInput = stringInput.substring(0, stringInput.length() - 1) + "dot";
            }
        }

        // Output the final string
        System.out.println(stringInput);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
